_experiment.description: Adjust step ablation. Identical to baseline but with do_adjust=false: the algorithm selects the weight that minimises d_W at each step but performs no gradient compensation afterward. Isolates the contribution of the OBS-style correction step from the search criterion. Expected result: accuracy degrades sharply much earlier than the baseline, confirming that the adjust step is responsible for the flat region of the sparsity curve.
literature: LeCun et al. 1989 (OBD): prunes by Hessian-diagonal saliency with no weight correction — the no-adjust case is the OBD analogue in the manifold framework
Dong et al. 2017 (layer-wise OBS): identifies the weight-correction step delta_w = -(w_q / [H^-1]_qq) * H^-1 * e_q as the key OBS innovation over OBD — this experiment tests the manifold equivalent
